scope: Installer integrity investigation; not a release qualification

report.hardware: User-reported Intel-based Mac; model, RAM and USB writer not supplied
report.symptom: After formatting, copying Firefox fails with hash mismatch importing path
report.original_machine_root_cause: Unresolved: no original media, live-store dump or kernel logs available

public_image.fresh_download: pass: independently downloaded all bytes; exact published size and SHA-256
public_image.packed_store: pass: 3641 registered paths, 34856758904 NAR bytes, verified after extraction
public_image.booted_store: pass: all 3644 registered live-store paths verified in an 8 GiB UEFI VM before fault injection

firefox.agreement: The screenshot's expected hash, binary-cache metadata, local cached package, extracted public ISO and unmodified booted ISO agree.

reproduction.classification: Deliberate fault injection into the exact public ISO's temporary live store; not proof of the original Mac's corruption source
reproduction.virtual_hardware: QEMU 11.1.2, KVM, q35, OVMF 202608, 4 host vCPUs, 8192 MiB RAM, read-only USB ISO, disposable 80 GiB NVMe target
reproduction.mutation: Change Firefox application.ini version text from 158.0 to 158.1, preserving file and NAR size
reproduction.old_preflight: pass despite corrupt Firefox; the shipped helper reports Prepared and Preflight passed
reproduction.old_install: fail after partitioning and formatting: hash mismatch importing the same Firefox store path
reproduction.comparison_with_report: Same path, expected hash, installer stage and failure message; injected actual hash deliberately differs from the user's screenshot
reproduction.nix_implementation: Nix 2.35.3 LocalStore::doAddToStore hashes the incoming NAR stream through TeeSource while restoring it. This error does not itself establish a target-disk read-back failure.
reproduction.fixed_install_corrupt: pass: the rebuilt real ISO refuses the identical same-size Firefox corruption during live-store verification; no Prepared or Progress/formatting events
reproduction.fixed_target_comparison: pass: SHA-256 of the entire 85899345920-byte disposable target matches before and after refusal

fix: Verify every registered live-store path before evaluation, including locally available inputs for deferred installation.
Verify the prepared system's recursive runtime closure after building and before returning Prepared.
Treat every nonzero verification result as failure; retain cancellation and show path-count progress.
Save expected/actual hashes and kernel warnings in a root-owned mode-0600 diagnostic under /run.
Make the public ISO derivation unpack and verify its actual squashfs against the build's closure registration before ISO assembly.
Keep copy-time integrity checking, signature policy, privilege boundaries, input locks and separate Cargo workspaces unchanged.

validation.installer_vm: pass: network-free BIOS component VM, real packaged helper and Determinate Nix; corrupt and missing paths refused, full 40 GiB target unchanged, diagnostics private and without the synthetic password
validation.image_gate_component: pass: real tiny ISO build plus six rejected corruptions (contents, executable bit, symlink, empty directory, missing path, registration)

validation.diagnostic_iso: pass: full published-revision ISO rebuilt with the integrity patch; mandatory gate verified 3641 packed paths; booted successfully as read-only USB
validation.clean_install: pass: the rebuilt real ISO completed an 80 GiB NVMe/UEFI/ext4 Aizome + Firefox installation through the actual helper, including copy, activation, bootloader and unmount
validation.main_iso: not built: the full diagnostic image intentionally uses the published input revisions to isolate the installer change; main was evaluated/dry-run separately
validation.disk_only_boot: pass: no ISO or installation share attached; normal Aizome greeter and actual keyboard login observed at original 1280x800 resolution
validation.flake_warnings: Existing etc-yukimi-system.json derivations reference a source without context; lib is an unchecked custom flake output.
validation.installed_firefox: pass: NAR hash still matches the screenshot expected value after disk-only boot; Firefox window opens through ordinary desktop keyboard input
validation.shutdown: pass: installed desktop power menu and confirmation shut down the VM; all three investigation QEMU processes exited and PID files disappeared

fixture_notes: Component VM uses a temporary root, a synthetic mounted ISO for the live guard, a marked disposable disk, and a deliberately absent configuration template. The healthy control must reach configuration; corrupt inputs must fail earlier. This is not an installation certification.

An expanded component attempt produced no result and had no live QEMU process when inspected; it was canceled. The final fixture removes its unnecessary inter-VM network and passed. No product defect or specific harness root cause is inferred from that stalled attempt.

The real-ISO reproduction and recovery experiments invoke the actual helper over QGA with a synthetic request. No test_diagnostics setting, autologin change, package injection or greeter substitution is used.

The installed system does not expose QGA. The diagnostic guest-agent request timed out; disk provenance is collected through the ordinary desktop terminal instead, without changing installed services.
limits: The reporter's exact ISO filename and checksum were not confirmed; the investigation used the current download-page image, whose Firefox path matches the report.
No stock-image failure was observed before deliberate corruption. USB/media read faults, RAM faults and live-store changes remain possibilities, not diagnosed causes.
Verification cannot guarantee against failures occurring afterward. Nix copy continues to reject changed input instead of installing unchecked bytes.
Deferred installs verify the available live store before formatting; unavailable downloads and builds still occur afterward and can fail independently.
The full diagnostic candidate uses the published revision with only the integrity changes. It is separate from main and is not a qualified replacement release.
No publication or release workflow was enabled or run. The public download remains unchanged.

verification_cost: Streaming full-store hashing adds preparation time and media reads. Initial verification took 193 seconds and the prepared closure took 36 seconds in this 8 GiB VM, with visible helper progress. These are diagnostic timings under host load, not physical USB benchmarks.
